chattranslation.config.title: Chat Translation Settings
chattranslation.config.target_language.t: Language code for translation. Use 'auto' to follow your Minecraft language setting.
chattranslation.config.translate_outgoin: 일반 채팅을 보내기 전에 번역합니다. 명령어는 번역하지 않습니다.
chattranslation.config.translation_servi: ai_free is the built-in free DeepSeek endpoint and needs no setup. Choose ai to use your own AI-compatible endpoint.
chattranslation.config.ai_api_key.toolti: Only needed for the ai service. The built-in ai_free service uses an embedded key, so this can stay empty.
chattranslation.config.show_original.too: Keep showing original message alongside translation.
chattranslation.config.translate_all_mes: Translate all chat and system messages, not just player chat.
chattranslation.config.notice: Saving reloads the selected translation provider immediately. Insecure SSL should only be enabled temporarily for troubleshooting.
chattranslation.config.free_notice: The built-in free endpoint uses deepseek-v4.1-flash through api.mcapple.top. Its key is embedded and encrypted in the mod; the public quota is shared, so expect slower replies and occasional failures.
